verdict.rationale: Bland documents a first-party MCP server and plugin that let AI agents operate a Bland account through natural language. Covered actions include placing and inspecting calls, sending texts, building and validating pathways, managing agents, querying analytics and running evals. The probe confirms the official MCP server exists. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language console (operation runs through an external AI agent), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and depth documentation on command coverage and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Bland MCP server lets any AI agent work with your Bland account through natural language: place and inspect calls, send texts, build and validate pathways, manage agents, query analytics, run evals
The Bland plugin is the recommended way to connect a coding agent to Bland.
